info.title: CodeBridge AI API
info.description:
CodeBridge AI is a RESTful API for user authentication, question management, AI-assisted question improvement, API consumption tracking, and administration.

**API Version:** v1 (`/api/v1`)

**Authentication:** Protected endpoints require a JWT stored in an HttpOnly cookie. Log in through the client application before testing protected endpoints.

**Testing:** Read requests can be tested through Swagger. Write operations must be performed through the configured client application.

get.description: Session-scoped; no user ID/query parameter. Newly registered users start at totalUsage=0 and remainingCalls=20. At 20: allowanceExhausted=true, limitExceeded=false. At 21+: limitExceeded=true; services continue. remainingCalls never negative. total/threshold are compatibility aliases. Breakdown groups HTTP method + normalized endpoint; errorCount counts status >=400. This read is not counted.
